## Highlights ### 🧩 New Models This release is the largest model drop since the KerasHub rename: twelve new model families spanning text encoders, embedding models, vision-language models, and a new diffusion-based text generation paradigm. - **ModernBERT**: A modern BERT-style encoder with RoPE, alternating local/global attention and an 8K context window, for masked language modeling and text classification. ([#2518](https://github.com/keras-team/keras-hub/pull/2518)) - **ModernBERT Text Embedder**: Sentence embedding models on the ModernBERT encoder, producing 768-dimensional vectors for retrieval and semantic search, with the Nomic and Alibaba GTE fine-tunes. ([#3150](https://github.com/keras-team/keras-hub/pull/3150)) - **MPNet**: The sentence-transformers family of 768-dimensional sentence embedding models for semantic search, clustering and paraphrase mining. ([#3181](https://github.com/keras-team/keras-hub/pull/3181)) - **EmbeddingGemma 2**: A 744M-parameter multimodal embedding model built on Gemma 4 that maps text, images, video and audio into a shared 768-dimensional space.
